name: Focuscope
payText: Site says focus groups pay "$75, $100, or even $250"; "Average $150 incentive paid per study"; health panel "Compensation averages $100/hour"; paid at the conclusion of the project.
who: General public (plus health-condition panelists for medical studies) who complete a profile; Chicago- and LA-area facilities plus nationwide virtual projects
how: Fill out the sign-up form with your demographic details to join Focuscope's respondent community; they contact you when you qualify for a project.

name: Probe Market Research
payText: Site says: "Compensation varies by study and may range from $50 to $400+, with some specialized studies paying significantly more." No fee to join.
who: General public nationwide, matched to studies by profile and location; explicitly lists Seattle, Portland, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, and New York among its 25 metro areas
how: Click Register on the sign-up page and complete the embedded registration form to join Probe's participant database.
